cornerstone.full_quote: The Cornerstone Investor has agreed that it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of six months from and including the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”), dispose of any of the Offer Shares it has purchased pursuant to the Cornerstone Investment Agreement, save for certain limited circumstances, such as transfers to any of its wholly-owned subsidiaries who will be bound by the same obligations of the Cornerstone Investor, including the Lock-up Period restriction, as the case may be.
cornerstone.basis: six months from and including the Listing Date; the six-month restricted period is inclusive of the Listing Date, so it ends the day before the six-month calendar anniversary
cornerstone.notes: H-share (Rule 19A) issuer; single cornerstone investor under the Cornerstone Investment Agreement dated March 19, 2026 (p. 424).

controller_6m.full_quote: Our Single Largest Shareholder has undertaken to each of the Company, the Sole Sponsor, the Sole Sponsor-Overall Coordinator, the Overall Coordinators, the Joint Global Coordinators, the Joint Bookrunners, the Joint Lead Managers, the Hong Kong Underwriters and the Capital Market Intermediaries that, without the prior written consent of the Sole Sponsor (for itself and on behalf of the Hong Kong Underwriters) and unless in compliance with the requirements of the Listing Rules: (a) it/he/she will not, and will procure that the relevant registered holder(s), any nominee or trustee holding on trust for it/him/her and the companies controlled by it/him/her will not, at any time during the First Six Month Period, (i) sell, offer to sell, accept subscription for, contract or agree to allot, issue or sell, mortgage, charge, pledge, hypothecate, lend, grant or sell any option, warrant, contract or right to purchase, grant or purchase any option, warrant, contract or right to sell, or otherwise transfer or dispose of or create an encumbrance over, or agree to transfer or dispose of or create an encumbrance over, either directly or indirectly, conditionally or unconditionally, any Shares or other securities of our Company or any interest therein
controller_6m.basis: voluntary six-month disposal undertaking by the Single Largest Shareholder under the Hong Kong Underwriting Agreement; the First Six Month Period runs up to and including the date which is six months from the Listing Date (inclusive endpoint), so the first free day is the day after the anniversary
controller_6m.notes: No Controlling Shareholder: 0664 is an H-share issuer with no Rule 10.07 undertaking; Mr. Yu (executive Director) is the Single Largest Shareholder (~23.24% post-Listing, p. 52). 'First Six Month Period' is defined in the Company undertaking on p. 255 as 'up to and including the date falling the date which is six months from the Listing Date'. A similar undertaking to the International Underwriters is described on p. 257.

controller_12m.notes: No 12-month control-maintenance undertaking exists. Searched all 441 pages for '10.07', '12 months', 'control of the Company', 'Controlling Shareholder', 'undertak'. The issuer has no Controlling Shareholder (Single Largest Shareholder only). The only 12-month restriction is the PRC-law prohibition on all existing Shareholders disposing within the first 12 months following the Listing Date (p. 52), which is not a Rule 10.07(1)(b) control undertaking.
